independent_acceptance_bootstrap.scope: All acceptance-driving CIs plus every regime's hybrid-vs-three-comparator CVaR interval; other descriptive CIs not re-estimated.

physical_replay.scope: Repeated verification of the same prespecified representative traces; not additional independent cases.

observation_only_replay.boundary: Only measured pre-queue/arrival, delivered past history, current committed units, and same-source measured flow/end-queue/effective units are supplied. No true rates, future arrays, noise arrays or terminal schedule are supplied.

sensor_delivery.source_times: pre-service t-lag; feedback after t uses source t-lag; latest before decision t is t-1-lag

underload.scope: No zero-deficit requirement: a finite pipeline retains work even when underloaded.

limitations: All evidence remains synthetic and conditional on the declared model and case families.
Representative replay does not reconstruct every episode minute; all rows and inline invariants cover the full episode scope.
Selected confidence intervals were independently reconstructed; remaining descriptive intervals retain the tested frozen implementation.
